title: pickTrackerModel
responsibility: Select a Tracker model using its task route, provider preference, explicit pin and run history.

inputs.name: pickTrackerModel.item
inputs.description: Tracker item with its text, optional model pin and eligibility information.

inputs.name: pickTrackerModel.options
inputs.description: Optional routing and scheduled provider, successful prior runs, and the current clock.

inputs.name: retryTrackerModel.item
inputs.description: Tracker item to use when selecting a retry model.

inputs.name: retryTrackerModel.run
inputs.description: Previous attempt's model, effort, ladder position and pin status.

inputs.name: retryTrackerModel.cfg
inputs.description: Optional model ladder and provider preference for the next attempt.

inputs.name: retryTrackerModel.now
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds that choose the routing table; defaults to the current time.

outputs.name: pickTrackerModel
outputs.description: Selected model and effort with the work type and reason for the choice.

outputs.name: retryTrackerModel
outputs.description: Pinned model, next eligible model, or higher Sol effort for another attempt.
